notes.subject: car
notes.text: A unique silver pickup with the truck bed visible; usually this alone identifies the island.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Mostly dense tropical forest, with bright white sandy soil on some unpaved roads and palms in places.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: The standard bollard of its mother country: white with a red reflector on the front and a grey one on the back.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: The car also drove some very rural trails, and many small trail trekkers cover forest, beaches and lookouts.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: The built-up areas are in the northeast; the rest is mostly dense forest.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A boat trekker near the north coast hugs a steep, rocky coastline, with some of the white deck poking through the blur.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The coastal Jln Pantai road was covered by a regular trekker, so you see only a blur and no car back.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The harbour area has large cranes visible from many vantage points.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: A golf course on the northeast coast is covered by a trekker and, in places, by the car.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Famous for red crabs: a trekker walks among hundreds near Ethel Beach, and signs across the island refer to the crabs.
